timing: Added after observing A's free WAIT behavior; not a prospective intervention or preplanned outcome of A.
question: After a command pulse, is its version linearly readable from native state when an autonomous BEGIN is still feasible?

sample_rule.target: original midpoint oracle target is BEGIN 1 or 2; binary label target-1
sample_rule.no_pulse: all this-job public kind[0:3], version[3:5], payload, duration, window and context pulse coordinates exactly zero
sample_rule.current_input: raw entire public observation in its original 56-coordinate order, without oracle/readiness/request metadata
sample_rule.state: post-step/post-observation-pulse h, original recorded parameters, all80 nodes in original index order
sample_rule.weights: one row per selected live tick/job, including repeated positions of a request; not independent-request samples

splits.excluded: all other time/actor combinations; no data-driven subset choices
splits.request_identity: original case_id + job + request_id; exact no train/test intersection required
splits.fitting: separate seed/job classifier; no cross-seed/job fitting

features.name: non_input_state
features.order: ascending complement of model.input_ports; excludes all56 input port nodes

features.name: native_begin
features.order: argmax of native logits[...,1:3]; no fitted parameters

ridge.standardization: unweighted training-row population mean and population standard deviation only
ridge.zero_variance: exact zero training variance columns excluded; effective standardized coefficient fixed zero
ridge.class_balance: each training class total loss weight1/2; total weight1
ridge.fitting: closed-form float64 linear solve, no tuning, no search, no threshold fitting
ridge.prediction: score>=0 predicts version1, else version0; native ties use original torch.argmax version0

metrics.primary: held-out balanced accuracy = mean of per-class recalls
metrics.save: class denominators, confusion counts, ordinary accuracy, recalls, number of requests, observed pulse ages, fixed standardization/coefficients
metrics.uncertainty: six seed/job descriptive results; actors, repeated ticks and jobs are not independent training seeds

reconstruction: one original step per recorded tick; original model-action, block start_h/end_h, world observation/oracle/request-version and world end hash must all match
limitations: Decoding uses external fitted readouts; it does not show autonomous action ability.
Current cue is excluded, but earlier pulse history remains in native state; this is not a long-memory test.
All labels and request identities are analysis-only and never model/probe features.
Time and actor changes both separate held-out data; the probe is not optimized on the held-out set.
